_comment: sshcheck CVE database — external version of SSH_VULNERABILITIES in sshcheck.py. Each entry uses a serialisable 'version_check' dict instead of a Python lambda. Supported check types: range, range_exclude, lt, gte, always_false.

OpenSSH.name: regreSSHion
OpenSSH.description: Race condition in signal handler allows unauthenticated remote code execution

OpenSSH.name: OS command injection via ssh and ssh-keygen
OpenSSH.description: OS command injection via expansion tokens in certain conditions

OpenSSH.name: Terrapin Attack
OpenSSH.description: Prefix truncation attack on Binary Packet Protocol (BPP) with ChaCha20-Poly1305 or CBC with Encrypt-then-MAC

OpenSSH.name: Remote code execution via ssh-agent forwarding
OpenSSH.description: Remote code execution via PKCS#11 providers in forwarded ssh-agent

OpenSSH.name: Privilege escalation via AuthorizedKeysCommand/AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand
OpenSSH.description: sshd allows privilege escalation because supplemental groups are not initialized as expected

OpenSSH.name: Command injection via scp
OpenSSH.description: Command injection via backtick characters in scp target filenames

OpenSSH.name: SCP client spoofing via object name
OpenSSH.description: SCP client allows server to write arbitrary files via modified object names

OpenSSH.name: Username enumeration
OpenSSH.description: User enumeration via malformed authentication requests

OpenSSH.name: Username enumeration via auth timing
OpenSSH.description: Allows remote attackers to enumerate valid usernames via timing differences
